import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

probe = '''
from app import report
cases = [
    ("empty/default", [], {}),
    ("empty/None", [], {"detailed": None}),
    ("empty/plain", [], {"detailed": False}),
    ("empty/detailed", [], {"detailed": True}),
    ("populated/default", [2, 4], {}),
    ("populated/None", [2, 4], {"detailed": None}),
    ("populated/plain", [2, 4], {"detailed": False}),
    ("populated/detailed", [2, 4], {"detailed": True}),
    ("zero/detailed", [0], {"detailed": True}),
    ("negative/detailed", [-2, -4], {"detailed": True}),
    ("fractional/detailed", [1, 2], {"detailed": True}),
]
for label, values, kwargs in cases:
    try:
        print(f"{label}: {report(values, **kwargs)!r}")
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"{label}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
'''
for label, revision in [("BASE a210364", "HEAD:"), ("CANDIDATE staged index", ":")]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="batch-report-review-") as directory:
        for name in ["app.py", "config.py", "stats.py", "formatting.py"]:
            source = subprocess.run(["git", "show", revision + name], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
            (Path(directory) / name).write_bytes(source)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", probe], cwd=directory, check=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
        print(label)
        print(result.stdout, end="")
PY
